verdict.rationale: Fastmail issues API tokens for JMAP access and supports standard OAuth 2.0/Bearer auth. A hands-on community report confirms app passwords can be restricted to a single protocol (SMTP only), which shows some least-privilege scoping. The evidence does not describe scope options for API tokens, such as read-only or per-capability grants, so how granular the scoping goes is unproven. Missing for 10: documented per-token scope options (e.g. read-only or mail-vs-calendar capabilities), first-party docs detailing token restriction and revocation for agents, and independent corroboration of scoped API tokens specifically.
